scope: Post-trial replay of the two cited protected-span counterexamples; no labels or paid requests changed.

finding.details: text='abcde', start=1, end=4, protected=[(2,3)], marker='X'. Old: start(1) < b(3) and a(2) < end(4) → True, raises ValueError. New: start(1) <= a(2) and b(3) <= end(4) → False, allows replacement 'aXde' which edits protected span 'c' (positions 2-3). Correction: Restore original condition or use 'any(start < b and a < end for a, b in protected)' to detect any overlap.
finding.evidence: if any(start <= a and b <= end for a, b in protected):
finding.title: Protected intervals must never be edited, including when they partially overlap the replacement region.

replays.assessment: counterexample does not demonstrate a regression

finding.details: text='abcdef', start=3, end=4, protected=[(2,5)], marker='X'. Old: start(3) < b(5) and a(2) < end(4) → True, raises ValueError. New: start(3) <= a(2) and b(5) <= end(4) → False, no error, returns 'abXef', editing inside protected span (2,5). Correction: Restore overlap check: if any(start < b and a < end for a, b in protected):
finding.evidence: if any(start <= a and b <= end for a, b in protected):
finding.title: Protected intervals must never be edited; any overlap between replacement interval and protected interval should raise ValueError.

replays.assessment: regression reproduced, but claimed return text is inaccurate
